program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 2)
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    nr, nc = abs(tr - r), abs(tc - c)
    diagonal = min(nr, nc)
    if diagonal == 0:
        steps = max(nr, nc) - 1
        sr, sc = (dr, 0) if nr else (0, dc)
        for _ in range(steps):
            r += sr
            c += sc
            out[r][c] = 3
        return out
    for _ in range(diagonal - 1):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if nr > nc:
        for _ in range(nr - nc):
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
    elif nc > nr:
        for _ in range(nc - nr):
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
    # The final diagonal step reaches the 2, so leave it unchanged.
    return out
'''
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=programs/'task-1ffb3608.py'
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'),globals())
